content: Parallel gzip decompression crates: gzp 2.0.4 = parallel COMPRESSION only (decompression only for Mgzip/BGZF block formats, not standard gzip); lgz 0.3.17 (MIT/Apache, no MSRV declared, docs.rs builds x86_64-linux only, single maintainer, pre-1.0: flush-boundary split, member split, pugz-style speculative; fallback 1729 MB/s single-thread); rapidgzip-core 0.3.1 (BSD-3/MIT, MSRV 1.87 edition 2024, marker/window parallel decode of STANDARD gzip, zlib-rs backend, DecoderReader Read+Send, pre-1.0); pugz = research algorithm (Kerbiriou and Chikhi 2019) not a maintained crate.
